title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-9n2n: deferred mark_response_used after AEAD encrypt creates nonce reuse risk
description:
In protect_response() when include_piv=false, the change defers mark_response_used(request_seq) to AFTER aead_encrypt_in_place_detached succeeds. If encrypt_in_place_detached modifies ct_out in-place and then fails (or the subsequent extend_from_slice(&tag) panics/fails), the sequence is NOT marked used but the buffer was already encrypted with the nonce. A retry with the same request_piv would pass is_response_reuse() and produce nonce reuse, which is cryptographically catastrophic for AES-CCM.

The old code called mark_response_used BEFORE the crypto operation, so a failed encrypt couldn't retry with the same sequence. The deferred pattern breaks this defense-in-depth.

Fix: move mark_response_used before aead_encrypt, or call it in a drop-guard / failure handler that ensures marking even on error paths.
